myanmarExcerpts.text: The weekly numbers of COVID-19 cases reported on official websites for Bangladesh 6 , Bhutan 7 , India 8 , Myanmar, Nepal, and Thailand are presented in Figure 3.

myanmarExcerpts.text: Maldives reported relatively high percentage of test positivity in the region with 46% while Myanmar reported 38% (Table 2).

The highest test positivity percentages were reported by Maldives (46%; up from 32%) and Myanmar (38%; up from 25%). Compared with the previous reporting period, influenza test positivity increased by 44% in Maldives while it increased by 52% in Myanmar.
